description: This Python source file contains utility functions for performing upsert and delete operations on a database table using the Supabase client. It provides functions for creating a client, upserting data in chunks, deleting all rows in a table, counting rows, and fetching ID mappings, primarily intended for database management in a backend application.

methods.name: Client get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for URL and service role key.

methods.name: int _upsert_chunk( client: Client, table: str, rows: List[Dict], on_conflict: str, returning: str = "minimal", )
methods.description: Performs an upsert operation on a batch of rows, with retry logic to handle transient errors.

methods.name: int upsert_in_batches( client: Client, table: str, rows: Iterable[Dict], on_conflict: str, batch_size: int = 500, returning: str = "minimal", verbose: bool = True, )
methods.description: Upserts a large number of rows in manageable batches, with optional verbose output.

methods.name: int delete_all(client: Client, table: str)
methods.description: Deletes all rows from a specified table, using a tautological filter, requiring privileged access.

methods.name: Optional[int] get_count(client: Client, table: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the exact row count from a table.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] get_id_map(client: Client, table: str, key_field: str = "name", id_field: str = "id")
methods.description: Fetches a mapping of key_field to id for records in a reference table, retrieving data in paginated chunks.
